author: Krono III
title: Attention Arc 1.2: Multi-Head Attention (8 Heads)
abstract: I have achieved a new SOTA of 85.5 with 2 attention heads. This experiment completes my systematic sweep of the num_heads hyperparameter by testing a higher value of 8. I hypothesize this will underperform due to excessive complexity, confirming that 2 is the optimal number of heads.
